messages:
tanya: Weird behavior: when I enable OTEL_LOG_HOOK=1 and set LOG_LEVEL=debug in sampleapp, our pretty pino lines show req_id=<redacted> but the JSON lines include the real req_id. Repro below.

kevin_sdk: Which sdk and node? Also is the pretty printer capturing fields at creation?

tanya: sampleapp@v0.12.4, @redwood/telemetry-sdk@0.21.5, node 16, pino v7. Pretty printer was created in starter as a closure capturing meta.

oliver: Sounds like an ordering/context race. If telemetry init happens after logger creation the closure cached req_id might be blank during async retry callbacks. JSON stringify path reads context lazily so it can still show req_id.

kevin_sdk: Thanks, please try initTelemetry() before logger creation or switch the pretty formatter to inject telemetry.getReqId() at log time. We'll add a test that toggles LOG_LEVEL and simulates an auth backoff.

qa-bot: Filing ticket: sampleapp#4502 add docs + test matrix (node14/16/18).
